title_en: From Scroll to Chat to Cart: Trends Reshaping How India Shops
excerpt_en: On the sidelines of the 2026 Meta Marketing Summit E-Commerce edition, we are sharing key trends shaping the future of shopping in India — from the rise of AI-powered discovery and video-first commerce to the growing role of conversational messaging in driving transactions.
